title: PersonaMix Solo #19 (솔로 · 옥=용녀 · 옥 라벤더 · 앵글 하이앵글 70도 · 체형 amazon bombshell · 인종 Chinese · 메이크업 비닐 블랙립 5단계 · 극한 · 배경 고성 안뜰(황금빛 오후) · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, mid 30s, an Eastern dragon princess of mythology, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, half-up half-down auburn hair — full body polished carved lavender jade fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid jade curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted jade sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING soft lavender-violet jade surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID pale mauve and white veins running between the sections, with fine gold inlay lines tracing every joint between the sections, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: leaning against a pillar with one arm resting on it, one knee bent — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of the same jade, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each longer than her middle finger, made of the same jade with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT jade — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-black wet-look eyeshadow with a blinding chrome highlight across the lids, a thick graphic black liner, razor-sleek lashes, liquid mirror-gloss black vinyl lips reflecting the light, a razor-sharp cool contour.

Background: a sunlit castle courtyard with a worn cobblestone floor, a standard-height arched gate, low stone steps and a waist-high well edge, in warm golden late-afternoon light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length steep high-angle shot taken from far above with a long telephoto lens, the camera directly above and in front of her angled roughly seventy degrees downward as if from a high ceiling or drone, flat telephoto compression with natural proportions and no wide-angle distortion, the whole figure from head to boots fully visible, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
